rule_versus_reading.direction: every disagreement is the word floor misfiling a short technical claim as an acknowledgement, or passing a long non-technical note as substantive; the rule is conservative about what it calls substantive

interpretation: of 105 user-written addressed edges, 59 (56.2%) are substantive engineering prose, 18 (17.1%) route the review point onward to a machine or are GitHub's own button text, and 28 are acknowledgement only; the rule and a full hand reading of all 105 texts disagree on 10 rows (9.5%); the adjusted later-merge contrast is 0.1735 [0.0726, 0.2744] for any edge and 0.1684 [0.0374, 0.2994] when only a substantive edge counts as exposure, against 0.0873 [-0.2062, 0.3808] when only a routing edge counts
scope: descriptive content classification of the exposure text plus a subgroup re-estimation; the subgroup contrasts are underpowered by construction and are reported as description, not as a causal decomposition
